data.title: 埃塔 · 史莱姆装备试作一号
data.description: 庭园地下实验室里，埃塔穿着白大褂，对着新试作的史莱姆装备记录数据。她睡眼惺忪，笔下的数据却精确到小数点后三位。
data.location: underground laboratory with workbenches, slime tanks, scattered blueprints and potion bottles
data.action: writing test data on a clipboard beside a slime equipment prototype, sleepy eyes, lab coat
data.lighting: 实验室魔石灯的冷白光与试剂的微光
data.mood: sleepy genius at work, precise madness
data.promptProse: Half asleep over a clipboard, Eta records the slime prototype's data to three decimal places. Genius does not need to be awake.
data.animaCaption: Sleepy eyes, flawless data — Eta's lab runs on Shadow Wisdom and stubbornness.
